title: K0 name resolution is a total package function
decision: Resolve a manifest-closed package and its function entry in two passes, reject active shadowing and ambiguous candidates, serialize full identity tuples with short hashes, and require Core lowering to consume only closed resolved ASR.
dissent: Rejecting active shadowing is stricter than many systems languages.
Package-wide contract ID uniqueness can require longer labels in large packages.
A separate static pass is still needed to resolve field projections.

compatibility.source: Active shadowing and ambiguous qualified paths become rejected.
compatibility.semantic: Every accepted path has exactly one serialized identity.
compatibility.proof: Determinism and layer-reachability proofs gain a resolved-ASR premise.
compatibility.tooling: Consumers must stop repeating lookup from unresolved path arrays.
